column1: # Real English typos from the ITE Typing dataset: Katri Leino, Markku Laine, Mikko Kurimo
# and Antti Oulasvirta, Aalto University, 2024, doi:10.5281/zenodo.12528162, CC BY 4.0.
# Each word a participant's phone autocorrected, typed on a mobile device; the word as
# typed, the word the sentence held, and what the phone wrote.
# 489,414 autocorrected words, 484,696 on mobile devices. Left out: 43,511 not all letters, 53,026 typed as meant,
# 60,095 under 3 letters, 94,023 typed as another word the pack holds, 987 meant as a word the pack lacks.
# 91,782 distinct pairs are eligible; these are 1000 sampled at random. The phones wrote the word meant for 803 of them.
